about_the_game:
Send your heroes deep into the wilderness where volcanic magic twists lava into incredible forms with the KR Wrath of the Volcano Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is here with a new MV-sized tileset that is filled with flowing lava, glowing crystals, and scorched stones ready to help you create dangerous dungeons where one wrong step could leave your heroes missing a foot! A1, A2, A4, and 3 B sheets offer a variety of grass and dirt floors for your heroes to safely walk on while wandering between rivers of lava and glowing holes in the ground that almost certainly lead to lava lakes. Let them explore less lava-filled areas where burnt tree trunks are one of the only signs that normal plants used to grow there and old wooden bridges connect cliffs that are studded with massive boulders. Warn your players that there’s something mystical about the area with glowing rings of mushrooms and twisting plants rise out of the ground, and force hard decisions by having thin lines of lava criss-cross shortcuts so your players have to choose whether to be injured for a quick trip to next section or take their time with the longer, safer path.

13 character sprites for lava flows and glowing orbs give you even more ways to make your maps more dangerous! Have fountains of lava burst out of the ground so your players need to plan their movement carefully, or use large springs of lava flowing down cliffs as roadblocks until your players find a way to plug them to move deeper into the dungeon. And that’s not even the end of this pack! Each tileset also comes in a blue version so you can double the fun. Use the blue lava to show that the deadly heat has been decreased, or make it a fully magical volcano where mana is so dense that it can physically harm your heroes! Pick up the KR Wrath of the Volcano Tileset and challenge your heroes with maps that are too hot to touch!



The Wrath of the Volcano Tileset Includes (in yellow and blue versions):


Ground Tiles:

Lively lava with several different surrounding tile options
lavafall (with top and bottom blending tiles)
dark grasses and dirt for tons of contrast
path tiles
burnt grasses and lava grasses
rocks
pits
and more!


Walls:

Includes dirt walls with various tile tops – dirt, grass and lava


Also includes:

fully customizable cliff-building tiles
boulders
natural bridges
glowing doorways
glowing plants of many types
burnt-up trees and stumps
glowing mini-gardens with a balance of crisp foliage and illuminated lava plants
unusual lava-dwelling plants…just stamp them on your lava pits!
fire crystals of many shapes and sizes
and more!


Events and Animations:

rocks with lava flowing over (use in the middle of lavafalls)
lava “springs” with lots of patterns of flowing lava
wide lava river
glowing lava orbs!


Terms of Use:

This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.
OK to be used in Commercial projects
Contents can be edited
OK for use in games with gore
OK for use in adult-rated games
